SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, MIN(calendar_date) AS d0, MAX(calendar_date) AS d1, COUNT(*) AS days
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-25' AND DATE '2026-10-06'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY d0

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, (w.web_order_id IS NULL AND s.store_id = 900) AS undispatched_web,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, FALSE, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT SUM(net_sales) AS template_total,
         SUM(CASE WHEN NOT undispatched_web THEN net_sales END) AS corrected_total,
         SUM(CASE WHEN undispatched_web THEN net_sales END) AS undispatched_web_lines,
         SUM(CASE WHEN store_id = 900 AND NOT undispatched_web THEN net_sales END) AS web_part
  FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
)
SELECT m.*, (SELECT SUM(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS rpt_total,
       (SELECT SUM(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS rpt_web
FROM mine m

SELECT 'sales' AS t, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl,
       MIN(sale_date) AS mn, MAX(sale_date) AS mx, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS maxload
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-10-06'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), MIN(return_date), MAX(return_date), NULL
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-10-06'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_orders', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id), 0, MIN(CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)), MAX(CAST(dispatch_ts_utc AS DATE)), NULL
FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-20'

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order
),
l AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, s.store_id, p.category, w.status, w.dispatch_date, f.channel_code
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
)
SELECT 'store999_by_sale_date' AS k, ROUND(SUM(net_amount),2) AS v, COUNT(*) AS n FROM l WHERE store_id=999 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL SELECT 'zztest_nonstore999', ROUND(SUM(net_amount),2), COUNT(*) FROM l WHERE store_id<>999 AND category='ZZ Test' AND COALESCE(dispatch_date,sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_status_'||COALESCE(status,'none')||'_store'||store_id, ROUND(SUM(net_amount),2), COUNT(*) FROM l WHERE (status IS NOT NULL OR store_id>=900) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY status, store_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'other_store_ids_ge_900', store_id, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE store_id>=900) GROUP BY store_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'dispatch_null_but_delivered', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL

SELECT d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, COUNT(DISTINCT r.store_id) AS stores, ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales),0) AS net, ROUND(SUM(r.returns_net),0) AS ret,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_store s WHERE s.is_current AND s.store_id<900 AND (s.close_date IS NULL OR s.close_date>=d.calendar_date) AND (s.open_date IS NULL OR s.open_date<=d.calendar_date)) AS expected_stores
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=d.calendar_date AND r.store_id<900
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'calendar Sept 2026', 0, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2)
FROM net_lines n WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
